project.name: critical_surface_mapping
project.purpose: Map the persistence boundary surface separating global exclusion runaway from bounded continuation in parameter space.

governing_question.primary: For fixed D_eps and D_rho, what is the critical boundary lambda_c(kappa) at which full exclusion ceases to be guaranteed?
secondary: How does collapse-time divergence behave near the boundary?
How does IC dependence weaken as the boundary is approached?
How do D_eps and D_rho shift or reshape the boundary surface?

tier2.purpose: rerun candidate non-runaway and near-boundary points

primary_surface_slice.description: Map lambda_c(kappa) at fixed D_eps and D_rho.

secondary_surface_slices.activation_rule: Only run after primary_surface_slice is complete and reviewed.

stages.name: stage_A_coarse_scan
stages.action: Run coarse lambda scan for each kappa.
stages.goal: Locate intervals where regime class changes or soft-boundary indicators rise sharply.

stages.name: stage_B_bracket_detection
stages.action: Identify adjacent lambda values with differing regime outcomes or clear boundary signatures.
stages.goal: Create [lambda_low, lambda_high] critical brackets per kappa.

stages.name: stage_C_refine
stages.action: Rescan each bracket at successively finer lambda steps.
stages.goal: Reduce bracket width below target tolerance.

stages.name: stage_D_tier2_validation
stages.action: Rerun all mixed/persistent/candidate points and immediate neighbors at extended horizon.
stages.goal: Reject false persistence caused by finite T_max.

critical_interval_trigger: adjacent lambda points differ in hard regime class
adjacent lambda points differ by >= 50% in mean collapse time
adjacent lambda points show onset of IC timing overlap
adjacent lambda points show large increase in collapse-time variance
stop_when: or no hard crossing detected and soft indicators saturate at scan edge

all_required: at least one run survives to T_max without full exclusion
final_exclusion_fraction < 1.0 in at least one run
final_mean_rho > 0.0 in at least one run
same parameter point contains both collapsed and non-collapsed runs
all runs reach full exclusion before T_max

indicators: collapse times tightly clustered by IC
timing varies modestly with lambda or kappa
long-lived interfaces or rho plateaus appear

IC_overlap_index.definition: Measure of overlap among IC-specific collapse-time distributions at the same parameter point.

steps: compute min/max collapse time for each IC family

full_capture_for: one representative run per IC for all coarse points

boundary_table_schema.best_estimate_lambda_c_rule: midpoint of [lambda_persistent_lower, lambda_runaway_upper] when both exist; otherwise null

execution_order.name: baseline_reference
actions: run kappa=0.55 coarse lambda scan first
verify outputs, classification, aggregation, and timeseries integrity

execution_order.name: primary_surface_curve
actions: run coarse lambda scans for kappa in [0.1, 0.2, 0.35, 0.55, 0.75]
compute behavior class and candidate boundary brackets

execution_order.name: adaptive_refinement
actions: refine all detected brackets to step 0.001

execution_order.name: tier2_validation
actions: rerun all mixed/persistent/candidate boundary points at T_max=250

execution_order.name: surface_extension
actions: repeat P1-P3 at D_eps in [0.01, 0.02] with D_rho fixed
repeat P1-P3 at D_rho in [0.05, 0.1] with D_eps fixed

required_checks: all parameter points have exactly 9 runs unless explicitly overridden
timeseries length consistent with termination condition

set_true_if_any: std_time_to_exclusion rises by >= 2x relative to previous lambda at same kappa
mean_late_time_front_speed drops by >= 50% relative to previous lambda at same kappa
one or more runs survive to T_max

plots.name: lambda_c_vs_kappa
plots.purpose: primary boundary curve at fixed D_eps and D_rho

plots.name: phase_map_lambda_kappa
plots.purpose: color by behavior class and soft subclass

compute_budget_guidance.note: Actual run count depends on number of brackets detected.

minimum: obtain lambda_runaway_upper for each primary kappa
detect whether any primary kappa shows mixed or persistent behavior
target: resolve lambda_c(kappa) to bracket width <= 0.0005 for all primary kappas
validate candidate persistent points at extended horizon
produce first surface trend across D_eps or D_rho

allowed_claims: precritical delay band from soft indicators
